The Lifecycle of a Claim

The lifecycle of a claim,
before and after PMEX

Claims Lifecycle

1/4

Implement a revenue cycle platform that submits accurately, runs automatically, and gets smarter with every claim.

Without PMEX

Eligibility gets checked manually or skipped. Authorization gaps show up weeks after treatment. Claims go out with errors that could have been caught before submission.

With PMEX

Every claim is built on verified eligibility and clean authorization, and checked against payer-specific rules and requirements before submission.

Without PMEX

Denials arrive after the fact with no warning. Staff spend hours working appeals with no sense of what's winnable.

With PMEX

Denial risk is flagged before a claim is ever submitted, so your team can fix issues while there's still time.

Without PMEX

Every denial lands in the same queue. Staff manually decide what to work first, often guessing wrong.

With PMEX

Denials are automatically prioritized by value and win probability so your team works what matters most.

Without PMEX

Payments trickle in unpredictably. Reconciliation is manual and slow, leaving revenue unaccounted for weeks.

With PMEX

Every payment is matched and reconciled automatically. You always know what's been paid and what's still outstanding.
